docs: Clean-room proposal workflow. The behavior was observed in an unlicensed design demonstration of a discovery-to-statement-of-work product. No source, product names, sample copy, icons, or assets were copied. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme.
